label: External Target Example Verification Profile

criteria.summary: run_checks must observe a visible UI shell before the round can advance.
run_checks must confirm the created item persists before the round can advance.
grade_round must confirm the created item persists before the evaluator can release the round.

notes: Keep target-specific correctness criteria here so the harness core can compare observed values against evaluator-owned expectations.
Define core probes here when target_reached should require evaluator-owned evidence in addition to verifier-produced live proof.
Release-gate probes must use mode browser_journey or http_json, carry assertion_id, and point at target_manifest_key values published by run_target.
Supporting probes can still use http, browser, file_contains, json_value, or shell_command for liveness and diagnostics, but they cannot open target_reached on their own.
Use shared assertion_id values to bind criteria, verifier witnesses, and core-owned release gates to the same feature or workflow claim.
